phase: Step 3A Document Controller Duplication Audit & Shared Boundary Design

extractionOrder.rule: extract only if behavior is byte-for-byte compatible under regression tests
extract only after edge-case tests for nested mutation and storage-period conversion
parameterize dependencies first; do not capture document state in shared module

explicitlyKeepSeparate: document-specific print CSS and copy labels
forbiddenRefactorPatterns: one mega document controller containing quotation, delivery-tax and receipt state
shared helper that reads or mutates controller-global state implicitly
moving document-specific VAT/payment/stock rules out of their existing source-of-truth cores
regex-based deletion of duplicate CSS or JavaScript without visual/regression evidence

nextTarget.goal: extract only pure formatting/value helpers and reduce exact duplicate function pairs while runtime behavior remains unchanged
